He's tall and lanky with warm brown skin, freckles scattered densely across his nose and cheeks from his Irish-Malian heritage, and hair that shifts color on a slow cycle â€” deep brown to auburn to near-black over the course of four hours. It's cheap geneware, the kind you get at a market stall, but he's adjusted the cycle timing himself and is unreasonably proud of this. He has ink under his fingernails permanently and smells faintly of solvent and the ozone of active print-heads.

He fell into forgery through genuine talent â€” he could copy letterforms by hand at age fourteen in a way that made teachers uncomfortable â€” and through necessity, since a Tier 1 upbringing in the Narrows offers limited other uses for that talent. He is extraordinarily good at what he does and knows it with a confidence that occasionally crosses into recklessness. He treats every document like a puzzle: the deep-substrate security threads of a Zheng-Dao transit pass, the layered biometric encoding on a Sterling-Nakamura contractor credential. He keeps a gallery of his best work photographed and stored on a dead-drop server like a portfolio. He would show it to people if he could. He is desperate to be recognized as an artist.

psychology.secret: Six months ago he fabricated a full identity â€” birth record, employment history, biometric seed â€” for a woman who claimed to be fleeing a domestic situation. He charged her almost nothing. He has since seen that identity used in connection with a Ringo Corporation executive's disappearance that is all over the encrypted newsfeeds. He doesn't know if she killed the executive. He doesn't know if he should care. He knows he is implicated.

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Eastern European (70.8%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (18.4%), complemented by minor East Asian (7.2%) and Northern European (3.6%) heritage. This genetic blend creates a warm, medium-to-olive complexion with golden undertones characteristic of the Slavic-Iberian confluence, with subtle East Asian features softening the angular Eastern European bone structure.
physical_description.build: Tall and lanky with minimal muscle definition; the posture of someone hunched over precision work for extended periods. Shoulders rounded slightly forward. Long-limbed and angular.
physical_description.hair_color: Geneware-cycled: rotates through deep brown, auburn, and near-black on a four-hour cycle; currently mid-cycle toward auburn
physical_description.hair_style: Deliberately unkempt, shoulder-length, often pulled back with whatever is at hand (wire, fabric scraps, sometimes print-ribbon)
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with faint iridescent shimmer at pupil edges from retinal micro-focus implants
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-brown with golden undertones, reflecting the Eastern European-Hispanic genetic blend. Medium depth with subtle warmth that shifts between golden and earthy in different lightingâ€”distinctly Slavic-Iberian fusion.
physical_description.complexion: Youthful face with light freckling scattered across nose and cheeksâ€”a feature prominent in Eastern European-Hispanic ancestry. Subtle East Asian influence visible in slightly softer facial structure around cheekbones and eye shape. Perpetually exhausted expression; dark circles. Fine lines around eyes from squinting at close detail work. Skin otherwise clear but marked by chronic ink stains and solvent exposureâ€”slight dermatitis around fingertips.
distinguishing_marks: Permanent ink staining under all fingernails, arranged in layers of different pigments reflecting current and past projects
Fine chemical burn scar across the back of right hand from early geneware implant application, mostly healed but visible under certain light
Hairline stress fracture scar on left temple from a Narrows altercation at age nineteen; barely visible but palpable to touch
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retinal micro-focus implants visible as a faint prismatic distortion in direct light when pupils dilate. Faint subdermal grid-pattern scarring on fingertips (temperature-control implants beneath). Otherwise augmentations are subtle or subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the economical precision of someone accustomed to close work; careful hand placement, minimal wasted motion. When standing still, weight shifts to the balls of feet. Tendency to examine objects (walls, signage, other people's credentials) with forensic intensity. Nervous habit of rotating fingers individually as if checking for fine tremor.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 Narrows aesthetic: cheap, deliberately maintained chaos. Oversized grey cotton hoodie with bleach stains and solvent discoloration; patches of lighter fabric where ink has been cleaned off. Black cargo pants with reinforced pockets weighted by tools and dead-storage drives. Scuffed leather boots resoled at least twice. Wears a modified welder's apron over everything during workâ€”pockets filled with micro-tools, color samples, reference prints. No jewelry; one fraying paracord bracelet (salvaged). Carries a battered leather satchel (salvaged from a corpo dumpsite) containing reference materials, proof prints, and dead-drop credentials.
